title: The Armed Conflict, Testimony and Memory
goal: Report what witnesses, commissions and a Nobel laureate said about the armed conflict, with reported speech.

sections.title: The Armed Conflict, Testimony and Memory
body: This lesson is about the armed conflict in Guatemala (1960 to 1996) and how it has been investigated and remembered. Every claim about the conflict is attributed to the person or the report that makes it.
The grammar is reported speech: you know how to say what someone said (*dijo que vivía con miedo*) and how to cite a source with *según*.

items: I can report what someone said, with *dijo que* and the verb moved back in time.
I can say what the CEH and the REMHI reports said, attributing each claim.
I can put the main events of 1954 to 1999 in order.
